thread:
anya - PM: Quick sync — want to align on a lightweight playbook for concordance gating for Optimize recommendations (batching/caching/quant). Customer asks keep popping up re: "explainability" when we change quant profiles.

sam - Eng: +1. We need concrete launch criteria: perf delta tolerances, latency SLO hit rates, and a rollback path.

li - ML: Suggest measuring automated concordance score (evals) + customer sign-off threshold. If concordance drops > 2% on targeted prompt set -> alert and pause recommendations.

maria - Solutions: Customers won't tolerate too many false positives. Can we have a staged rollout: pilot customers only, then tiered opt-in?

anya - PM: Yes. Proposed stages: alpha (internal), closed pilot (3 customers), gradual GA with opt-in by default for small sessions. Documented rollback + explanation for customers.

sam - Eng: Implementation notes: the runtime can tag recommendations with variant metadata (quant profile, batch policy). That enables service-side metric joins for regressions.

li - ML: Eval-triggered alerts need to tie to canonical prompt set per customer. Two signals: automated eval concordance and live-response sample mismatch (customer feedback).

maria - Solutions: For pilots, we'll ship a short explanation template: "why we recommended X" and an opt-out flag. Also include an impact dashboard: tokens saved, p95 latency change, concordance delta.

devops-bot: deploy 5372103600 started -> canary to "optimize-pilot" pool

sam - Eng: For launch criteria draft:
- Concordance delta <= 1.5% vs baseline on customer prompt set
- Token cost reduction >= 8% for 99th percentile of pilot traffic
- No increase in error rate > 0.1% for 24h
- Rollback automation tested in staging

li - ML: Add quality guard: sample-level confidence check. If top-1 token perplexity increases significantly, suppress quant recommendation for that model/route.

anya - PM: Prioritized checklist for next sprint:
1) Define per-customer canonical prompt sets (maria + customer eng) — owner: maria
2) Instrument recommendation metadata in runtime (sam)
3) Eval pipeline alert hook + dashboards (li + eng observability)
4) Customer-facing explainer + opt-out UI (maria + UX)
5) Pilot recruitment & communications (anya)

maria - Solutions: I'll reach out to three pilot candidates — recommend AcmeHealth, ComposeAI, and TutorLabs.

sam - Eng: Tech constraints: quantization variants need GPU validation. We may start with int8 quant profiles only to reduce surface area.

li - ML: Also need to tag contexts where prefix caching will change outputs; caching + quant sometimes interacts badly for long-context models.

anya - PM: Decision: target int8 + caching heuristics for pilot. Must include an "explain" payload showing why recommendation chosen. If pilot passes, widen to other quant levels.

maria - Solutions: Customer ask: how do we measure "user-facing" regressions? Suggest tracked KPI: task success as defined by customer's eval or a proxy like completion length/signpost.

li - ML: OK. We'll add a small A/B harness to route a sample of queries to baseline model and compare downstream KPI.

sam - Eng: Risks noted: rollout complexity, extra telemetry volume. Mitigation: sample-level telemetry + aggregated deltas only for long runs.

anya - PM: Action owners and due dates:
- maria: pilot outreach + prompt sets by Tue next week
- sam: runtime tagging + canary deploy by Fri
- li: eval hook + alert config prototype by Fri
- eng-obs: dashboard stub by Mon

maria - Solutions: ack. I'll draft the customer-facing FAQ.

li - ML: ack. I'll start on the concordance metric definition doc and share a PR.

sam - Eng: ack. Will add feature flag for per-customer opt-in and rollback playbooks.

anya - PM: Great. We'll reconvene Wed 11am to review pilot readiness. :thumbsup:
